topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I seen the clouds gather, and though it's spring, it feels like the harvest is lost before it's even been sown. The old man from the mill came by, said his cousin found old things in the attic of his house. Things from long ago, tucked away 'neath the rafters, like secrets the walls kept. He spoke of wooden toys and faded letters, of shoes so small you'd think a saint had danced in them once. I can't shake the thought of them, those things left behind. It’s like finding the lost spring lamb, only to realize it’s been cold for years. I wonder what was said in those letters, what hands those shoes held. The miller's cousin will have a piece of something that's not quite his, a tale without an ending, and maybe that's the hardest part to bear.
